test_cases.scenario: Register page loads when AUTH_MODE=classic and self-registration is enabled
test_cases.steps: Configure AUTH_MODE=classic and ALLOW_REGISTRATION=true. Navigate to /register/.
test_cases.expected: Registration form renders. All fields are visible. No errors in the console.

test_cases.scenario: Authenticated user is redirected away from the register page
test_cases.steps: Log in. Then navigate directly to /register/.
test_cases.expected: User is immediately redirected to /dashboard/. The register form is not shown.

test_cases.scenario: CSRF cookie is set on register page load
test_cases.steps: Navigate to GET /register/. Open browser DevTools > Application > Cookies.
test_cases.expected: A csrftoken cookie is present after the page loads.

test_cases.scenario: Register page includes a link to the login page
test_cases.steps: Navigate to /register/.
test_cases.expected: A 'Sign in' or equivalent link is visible and navigates to /login/.

test_cases.scenario: All required fields are present on the registration form
test_cases.steps: Navigate to /register/.
test_cases.expected: First name, last name, email, password, and confirm password fields are all visible.

test_cases.scenario: Password fields are masked by default
test_cases.steps: Navigate to /register/. Observe the password and confirm password inputs.
test_cases.expected: Both password fields obscure characters (input type=password).

test_cases.scenario: App branding renders correctly on the register page
test_cases.steps: Navigate to /register/ after setting a custom app name.
test_cases.expected: Configured app name and branding appear correctly.

test_cases.scenario: Valid registration data creates an account and shows a success message
test_cases.steps: Navigate to /register/. Fill in: first name, last name, valid email, strong password (12+ chars, mixed case, digit, symbol), matching confirm password. Click Register.
test_cases.expected: 201 response. Success message shown (e.g. 'Account created. Please sign in.'). No session established automatically.

test_cases.scenario: Newly registered user can log in immediately after registration
test_cases.steps: Complete a valid registration. Navigate to /login/. Enter the registered email and password.
test_cases.expected: Login succeeds. User is authenticated and redirected to /dashboard/.

test_cases.scenario: Submit button shows loading state during registration
test_cases.steps: Fill in valid registration data. Click Register. Observe the button immediately after clicking.
test_cases.expected: Button is disabled and shows a loading indicator while the request is in-flight.

test_cases.scenario: Duplicate email address returns a 409 conflict error
test_cases.steps: Register with a valid email. Attempt to register again with the same email.
test_cases.expected: 409 error. Message indicates an account with that email already exists.

test_cases.scenario: Self-registration disabled returns a 403 error
test_cases.steps: Configure ALLOW_REGISTRATION=false. Navigate to /register/ and attempt to submit the form.
test_cases.expected: 403 error. Message indicates registration is not available.

test_cases.scenario: Weak password returns a 422 error with a descriptive message
test_cases.steps: Fill in the form with a password that is too simple (e.g. 'password123'). Submit.
test_cases.expected: 422 error. Message describes the specific password weakness (e.g. 'too common', 'missing special character').

test_cases.scenario: Empty first name shows a validation error
test_cases.steps: Leave first name blank. Fill in all other fields. Submit.
test_cases.expected: Validation error for first name field.

test_cases.scenario: Empty last name shows a validation error
test_cases.steps: Leave last name blank. Fill in all other fields. Submit.
test_cases.expected: Validation error for last name field.

test_cases.scenario: Empty email shows a validation error
test_cases.steps: Leave email blank. Fill in all other fields. Submit.
test_cases.expected: Validation error for email field.

test_cases.scenario: Invalid email format shows a validation error
test_cases.steps: Enter 'notanemail' in the email field. Fill in all other fields. Submit.
test_cases.expected: Validation error indicating invalid email format.

test_cases.scenario: Password shorter than 12 characters shows a validation error
test_cases.steps: Enter a password of 11 characters. Fill in all other fields. Submit.
test_cases.expected: Validation error indicating the password is too short (minimum 12 characters).

test_cases.scenario: Mismatched passwords show a validation error
test_cases.steps: Enter a valid password. Enter a different value in confirm password. Submit.
test_cases.expected: Validation error on confirm password: 'Passwords do not match.'

test_cases.scenario: All fields empty shows validation errors for all required fields
test_cases.steps: Navigate to /register/. Leave all fields empty. Click Register.
test_cases.expected: Validation errors shown for: first name, last name, email, password, confirm password.

test_cases.scenario: First name or last name exceeding 150 characters is rejected
test_cases.steps: Enter 151 characters in the first name field. Fill in all other fields. Submit.
test_cases.expected: Validation error indicating the field exceeds the maximum length.

test_cases.scenario: CSRF protection is enforced on the register endpoint
test_cases.steps: Attempt to POST to /api/v1/auth/register/ without a valid CSRF token (e.g. using curl).
test_cases.expected: Request is rejected with a 403 Forbidden error.

test_cases.scenario: Password is not returned in the registration response
test_cases.steps: Submit a valid registration form. Inspect the API response body.
test_cases.expected: No password, hash, or token is included in the success response.

test_cases.scenario: Registration page renders correctly on mobile screen sizes
test_cases.steps: Open /register/ in a browser. Resize window to 375×812px (or use mobile emulation).
test_cases.expected: Form is fully visible and usable. No overflow or broken layout.

test_cases.scenario: Registration form is accessible via keyboard navigation
test_cases.steps: Navigate to /register/. Use Tab key to move through all fields and Enter to submit.
test_cases.expected: All fields and the submit button are reachable via keyboard in a logical order.

test_cases.scenario: All form fields have accessible labels
test_cases.steps: Inspect the form HTML. Check each input for a label or aria-label.
test_cases.expected: Every input field has an associated accessible label.
